question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Susceptible
solution:
The correct answer is "**Impressionable**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word 'susceptible' means easily influenced or affected by something.**(भावुक)

 
 
• Example: She isn't very susceptible to flattery. 
 
 
 
• **'Impressionable' means someone easy to influence**.(प्रभावित)
 
 
• Example: Children are impressionable and often believe what they are told.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "impressionable" is the synonym of the word "susceptible."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, 'immune', means protected or resistant to something.(प्रतिरक्षा)
 
• Option 2, 'sceptical', means doubtful or questioning.(संशयी)
 
• Option 4, 'critical', means important or necessary.(गंभीर)
